note: Corps campground on a cove of Wappapello Lake in two parts about 850 m apart with separate entrances off Route D. The lower loop is wooded hillside with a lakeside bulb at its west end: sites 28 and 29 open onto the lawn and the campers' sandy boat-mooring beach, three walk-in tent sites sit on the shore, and the rest are in timber 100-350 m back. The upper loop is a wooded knoll of full-hookup sites above the marina cove, a road between it and the water. Shortest RV site 39 ft. The lower loop can flood at high lake levels. --Claude
summary: Confirmed open and bookable on recreation.gov: 50 RV sites (34 lower electric/water at $24, 16 upper full hookup at $28), all 39 ft or longer, 50 amp, showers, dump. Season May 5/6 to Sep 27/28; off-season status unread. Stored pin is on Route D between the two loops (move). Lakefront rests on two RV pads only - waterfront lead.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (stored lakefront): the stored note's '38 electric/water sites sit directly on the lake' is not what the imagery shows. Plotting the catalog coordinates: sites 02-25 are on a timbered hillside loop 100-350 m from the shore with no lake in sight on leaf-off imagery; sites 01, 31-35 are 80-120 m back behind the loop road; 26, 27 and 30 are on the lakeside bulb 40-70 m from the water with the bulb road or trees between. Only sites 28 (about 20 m from the bank, open) and 29 (about 35-40 m, open lawn and the sandy mooring beach, no road between) have an open apron within 50 m. The walk-in tent sites 36-38 are on the shore, and they are the only campsites the catalog itself tags 'Lakefront'. The upper loop (39-57) is 80-150 m above a marina cove through timber with a paved road between. So 2 of 50 RV pads are on the water. The operator does say 'Peoples Creek Lower section is the only campground at Wappapello Lake with waterfront campsites'. Owner's call whether two pads carry lakefront or it goes to lakeview; I left it. Imagery is at winter drawdown, so distances are to the upper edge of the sand, roughly normal pool.

PIN MOVE: stored 36.9464,-90.2753 is the rec.gov facility point, which lands beside a store on Route D between the two loops. Lower loop (34 RV sites, the lakeside one) centres on 36.95150,-90.27930, about 650 m NW; the upper loop centres on 36.94403,-90.27467, about 270 m S. Suggest 36.95150,-90.27930.
TWO LOOPS, NO SPLIT: lower and upper are about 850 m apart with separate entrances off Route D, but they are one recreation.gov facility with one calendar and under the 1 km line.

SEASON not written: recreation.gov's contact block says staffed 05/06/2026-09/28/2026 and 'unstaffed' 09/02/2025-05/05/2026; the rate table carries only Peak seasons for 2026-2028 (the last Non-Peak rows are 2021-2023); the calendar shows all 54 sites 'Not Available' for October, November, March and April and available from 2027-05-05. Whether the loops are gated or open walk-up outside the season I could not read: the Corps' Wappapello pages (mvs.usace.army.mil) answered 403, and a Wayback fetch was blocked by this session's permissions. The stored note's 'FCFS off-peak' is therefore unconfirmed and removed from the note; booking.fcfs left unwritten.
